# Chip Toggle

A filter you switch on and off: a button that remembers, not a checkbox.

In `library/components/chip-toggle/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-chip`

## ARIA

- **each chip** — `type=button` `aria-pressed`
- **a chip that is on or off rather than pressed** — `role=switch` `aria-checked`
- **the row** — `role=group` `aria-labelledby`

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — toggles
- `ArrowLeft / ArrowRight` — move within the row
- `Home / End` — first / last chip
- `Tab` — one stop for the whole set

**States:** pressed, disabled

## Goes wrong when

- a checkbox instead — aria-pressed is what says a button remembers
- aria-pressed added only once pressed, so the control appears mid-page to a screen reader
- a fill and nothing else, so the pressed state is carried by color alone (SC 1.4.1)
- a tick typed in CSS content, which is folded into the accessible name
- the label text swapped on toggle, so the name and aria-pressed announce a contradiction

**API:** `AC.createChipToggle(root) -> { toggle, refresh, element, destroy }`

WCAG 1.4.1 1.4.11 2.1.1 2.4.3 2.5.3 2.5.8 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) · see also `button`, `switch`, `checkbox`
